purpose: Teach: 霊魂/病床/擬似/昇華/接合/減免/詰め込ん/付託

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宗教における霊魂の概念を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the concept of the soul in religion in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Gentle prompt—not interrogating, inviting him to tell her more. Steady eye contact. The ease of a teacher who knows her student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、病床にあった作家の作品を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I examined the works of a writer during their illness.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Slight pause before answering—gathering his thoughts. Quiet confidence. Not defensive, just precise. The care of someone choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、擬似科学の批判を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also looked at critiques of pseudoscience in another piece.
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting threads. A slight lift at the end—not quite a question, but an opening for him to clarify. Genuine curiosity about where he's headed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、苦悩を芸術へ昇華した作家の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I studied how that writer transformed suffering into art.
lines.style: Quieter this time. A touch of vulnerability beneath the professional tone. He's moved by what he studied. Brief, because the weight of it is in the pause.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織と組織の接合関係史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the historical relationship between organizations—their intersections.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning slightly forward. She's noticing the pattern now. Warmer tone. Seeing how his thinking connects across subjects. Pulling it together for him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の減免政策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I researched wartime exemption policies and how they affected those structures.
lines.style: Steady, factual foundation. Then a slight softness underneath—this matters to him, the historical weight of it. Not rushed. Respectful of the subject.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、過剰に詰め込んだ教育課程の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Overcrowded curricula—that's another thread you've been following.
lines.style: Reflective, understanding dawning. She's piecing it together. Warm but clinical. Not leading him, but confirming she sees the shape of his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、議会への付託案件の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I researched cases that were referred to the Diet, how those decisions were made.
lines.style: Calm conclusion. The pieces click into place for him. Quieter than before—settled. He's explained what he needed to explain. Gentle fade on the final phrase.
